div.class: border rounded bg-light p-3 mb-3 o_cs_screen_guide
div.p: What is this screen? A controlled way to add existing Odoo companies to Customer Success.

ul.li: Find companies that already have support tickets or projects.
Import a limited batch and distribute it across available CSM engineers.
Optionally classify customer tiers during import.

div.p: Start here: Choose the source, check the candidate count, and begin with a small limit. Review team capacity before automatic assignment. Existing Customer Success accounts are skipped.

form.div: Imports companies that already had dealings with us (tickets or projects) and are not yet managed, then assigns them to CSM engineers.

button.name: action_import
button.help: Enroll the detected companies as Customer Success accounts, up to the selected limit. Existing managed customers are skipped; optional assignment uses the least-loaded eligible CSM first.
Close without enrolling any customers or changing CSM assignments.

field.name: help
field.p: Detect companies with existing tickets or projects that are not yet managed by Customer Success. Review the source, candidate count, limit, assignment, and AI tier options before importing.
